description: The native round driver (cpp/update_flow_core/round_engine.h), shared by the Android, iOS and Harmony orchestrators and replayed by scripts/test-update-flow-core.sh. `rounds`: each step feeds `event` to StepRound with the previous step's state and expects exactly `commands` (compared as JSON, key order ignored). A string "@name" anywhere in a round or a host case stands for fixtures[name]. `host`: HostCancellation. `safePath`: IsSafePathComponent. `before` records what a platform did where it disagreed before the engine replaced its hand-written loop. Hand-maintained.

rounds.name: no config: skipped, nothing marked
disabled config: skipped
blank appKey: invalid config
an env that is not an object: invalid request
up to date: commit the response cache only
up to date, then a reset wins the commit
a failed endpoint falls back to the next
an invalid response does not count
every endpoint fails: check_failed, nothing committed
endpoints fail, the remote list answers
download: diff on the first mirror, activation left to JS
download with afterDownload setNeedUpdate activates
forceBoot activates and marks the version info
already installed: commit without downloading
mirror retry: DOWNLOAD_FAILED tries the next mirror, PATCH_FAILED the next strategy
a failure without a code is mirror-retryable
every attempt fails: download_failed, the cache is still committed
the incremental budget runs out: pdiff is skipped, full opens its own window
the incremental budget spent by failures: the full window starts when full is reached
the full download times out: download_failed
a reset during the download wins the commit
a config change during the download wins the commit
the commit itself fails: commit_failed
no running version: no diff attempt, no originHash
an unsafe hash is an invalid response
crash hold: the deadline caps requests and downloads, the version is force-activated and marked
a crash hold that begins mid-round still force-activates
the round deadline passes during the query: check_failed
a deadline already past when the download would start: download_failed
forceActivate (the launch waits): activation asked, the commit reports it dropped
an event the phase does not expect: internal_error, later events ignored
an event without a round: internal_error
an event without a type: internal_error
an empty event without a round: internal_error
a new start replaces a finished round

host.name: the round's own config, nothing changed
the same config in another serialization is not a change
the round ran with another config
the stored config changed after the wait
a reset since the round started
a config change outranks a reset
